integrity: The lower bound is reconstructed from the published face criterion, three-polytope Euler arithmetic, affine dimension counting, and a proved equality-case join lemma. The sharp witness is checked directly from prism and dual-prism face counts. Finite code checks are used only for arithmetic consistency, not as a substitute for the structural proof.
scientific_limitations: The result gives the sharp vertex and facet thresholds in dimension seven but does not classify all size-minimal counterexamples or all non-free-join obstructions. The originality search cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed observations.
title: Eleven is the sharp size threshold for seven-dimensional vertex-facet assignment obstructions
